status: exploratory; all historical outcomes were previously inspected; protocol fixed before new run; no confirmatory claim
selection: One chronological 180-day pre-year validation block per state/year/mode/lead. Fitting labels strictly before validation first ORIGIN; validation labels <= previous Dec31. Select minimum validation MAE, deterministic grid-order tie-break. Freeze chosen hyperparameters for every refit that evaluation year, for both schedules. All data exploratory; none of the evaluation errors selects hyperparameters.
calendar: same seven weekday indicators and three annual sine/cosine pairs; regional mode adds same seven documented event channels as checkpoint, not new outcome-selected dates
input_availability: history uses only dates strictly preceding first-unseen origin; target-aligned annual lags are past for every declared horizon. Causal fill allowed for inputs; labels must be recorded positive values.
refit: At Jan1, or first of each month, fit using preceding 730 calendar days of label dates ending refit_date-1; purge direct multi-step labels so max fitting target < refit origin. Retain parameters until next refit; rolling observed-history features update daily.
cases: same dense daily-origin schedule as original expanded evaluation, Jan1-Dec18, 2026 ending Oct15 (all leads share origins).
scaling: For comparable reported MASE use fixed pre-year 730-day observed weekly-difference scale, identical to historical comparisons. Do not update score scale monthly.
reporting: every configuration, all/event/non-event, state/year/lead, fit/selection failures and logs, runtime; Chronos comparison on exact same cases. Event years 2024-25 only. No row-independence or significance claims.
primary_contrast: monthly minus annual MASE for each model and feature mode on identical cases, equal state/year weighting; no best-arm selection
limits: richer does not mean strongest possible baseline
single historical validation block and narrow fixed budget
